This directory vendors the FTML WebAssembly parser from Wikijump, used only at
build time by `tools/ftml_render_batch.mjs` to parse saved Wikidot source.

Upstream: https://github.com/scpwiki/wikijump
Source snapshot: local Wikijump checkout at commit ebd226a.
